# My Agent

This agent will help in the edition of this webpage.
The webpage consists of pages composed of html,css and javascript, each page has a "database" that it access, that database its a json file with all the info related to that page.
practically all the pages have a custom script to access the different formated json files.
There is also a CSS file with all the common styles used in the different pages, to avoid repetition.
The page is currently a work in progress, i need to add more datasets to new pages, and try to unify the style of all the pages, currently they are all different in that matter.
